messages.subject: Dynamic Energy Budget theory introduction
parts:
Dear NicheMapR users,

As you probably know, the NicheMapR package uses models derived from the Dynamic Energy Budget (DEB) theory for computing growth, development and reproduction.

DEB is a powerful but conceptually challenging theory and it took me a long time to digest it and then apply it. I recently wrote an overview of metabolic theory which puts the DEB theory into context with the 'von Bertalanffy' growth model and the 'metabolic theory of ecology', which may help you digest DEB further. Writing it certainly helped me!

DM me if you'd like a copy.

All the best,
Mike
